about: Byte caps on the tools/list result (compact JSON, as the stdio shim writes it) per schema profile, protocol version and role profile. Measured 2026-09-25 (WS-54); remember content made optional and the WS-19A lifecycle arguments added as Advanced 2026-09-26, and the WS-19B provenance and evidence-bound vote arguments the same day, and the WS-20 recall filters, disclosure and budget arguments and remember's kind, topic and tags the same day (full caps grew by exactly their cost each time; the WS-20 argument descriptions live at xmustard://docs/tools, not in the schema). WS-18 (2026-09-28): the search description now names BM25 over bodies and lost 59 bytes, search's outputSchema gained omitted and next_cursor (58 bytes, 2025-06-18 only), and the Advanced cursor and path_glob arguments cost 198 bytes in the full profile; lean caps were lowered to the measured sizes. WS-21 (2026-09-28): why_failed run_id became optional and the tool non-read-only (command mode runs commands); its lean entry shrank by 9 bytes at 2025-06-18 (command, off by default, left the description) and by 53 bytes at 2024-11-05 (caps lowered), and the full caps grew by exactly the cost of its five advanced source arguments (621 bytes at 2025-06-18, 577 at 2024-11-05). WS-20 review round 2 (2026-09-28): recall's Advanced session_id gained maxLength 128, 16 bytes in the full profile only. WS-35 (2026-09-28): impact's description now names the resolved Go/TS graph and its completeness (32 bytes shorter), max_depth allows 32 with a shorter description, and its outputSchema lists by_depth for impacted and risk (25 bytes, 2025-06-18 only): lean caps were lowered by the measured 18 bytes (2025-06-18) and 43 (2024-11-05). impact's twelve Advanced v2 arguments (direction, relation_types, min_confidence, include_tests, limit, offset, summary_only, timeout_ms, scope, base, head, worktree) cost the full profile 1,292 bytes at 2025-06-18 and 1,292 at 2024-11-05 over the lowered lean sizes; the full caps grew by exactly that (+1,274 and +1,249 over their old caps). WS-27 (2026-09-28): the recall description names the conflict tiers in 3 fewer bytes (lean caps lowered), and the full caps grew by exactly the cost of recall's Advanced include_merged, subject and predicate (161 bytes) and remember's Advanced claims and relations (125 bytes), described at xmustard://docs/tools. Lower a cap when the list shrinks; never raise one to fit an addition: advertise less (declare the argument Advanced, documented at xmustard://docs/tools) or trim a description. cmd/xmustard-api checks role_profiles against the route gates. WS-FIX-05 (2026-09-28): impact gained path= (file-level blast radius), listed in the lean schema by owner decision; every cap rose by exactly its measured 119 bytes (the path property 79, the description's path= clause 34, max_depth's description naming path= 6), for every profile, role and protocol version. WS-35 merged with WS-FIX-05 (2026-09-28): path= keeps its lean property, the description's clause became "path= → a file's lexical referrers" and max_depth's description "hops (default 3; path= 4)", and the caps are the measured sizes, 116 bytes above WS-35's lowered caps and below WS-FIX-05's (lean) in every profile, role and version. WS-27 merged after WS-35 and WS-FIX-05 (2026-09-28): WS-27's deltas applied to those caps (lean -3 everywhere; full +158 reader and verifier, +283 proposer and agent), and every cap equals its measured size. WS-36 (2026-09-28): search gained mode=symbol (an enum value, its mode description, and a description clause that replaced pattern mode's example, 4 bytes shorter) and explain's path stopped being required (explain also takes symbol= and uid=); together every lean cap fell by 5 bytes, and the full caps grew by exactly the 1,349 bytes of the new Advanced arguments over the lowered lean sizes (search max_chars, kinds, depth, include_body, include_info, substring; explain symbol, uid, depth, chain_depth, include_content, max_chars, limit, cursor; impact max_chars).
